_about: Wall patches in the half-cell: where two pieces of different regions meet. An interior patch lies on library surface 'surface' between pieces a and b (both in the same copy); a face patch lies in a domain face, with side b in copy multiplication[k, side_b_copy_shift] when side a is in copy k. The patch is exactly: the points of that surface where every other surface has the sign the two pieces share.
